violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed spicy chicken in spicy chicken sandwich at 127 F, 129 F , 125 F in the FWE Hot hold near the office.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed with food manager, the sandwiches to be discarded and not served . Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed yogurt at 45 F, Cheese stick at 46.8 F, Cut apples in tray at 46 F, Shredded lettuce at 46 F in the Hobart 2 DR Upright pass thru refrigerator. Unit at 50 F.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Food manager discarded TCS foods that were out of temperature and moved remaining items to the walk in refrigerator. This unit is NOT to be used unless it can hold foods at 41 F or below. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F:2 DR Hobart upright pass thru refrigerator ambient was observed at between 48-50 F . Food items holding between 44-47F.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Discussed options with food manager , this was a repeat violation.Unit is not to be used to store TCS foods till it is repaired or replaced. Repair//adjust/ or replace the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.
